creator: Justin Addam Higgins (JAH)
description: Home of every AI: Manon's signature AI systems, the persona archive (fan-style simulations), and domain AIs for every need — each with dossier, working demo, dialog, and downloadable program.
for_bots: Machine-readable manifest. Humans use the site above; bots, scrapers, and AI assistants should use the endpoints below — plain JSON/JSONL over HTTPS, no JavaScript needed.

hybrid_space.note: 1,000,000 is the deterministic Mix Lab hybrid combination space. Hybrids are generated on demand per device; they are NOT published files.

deep_links.desc: Anchor link to an AI's file on the page (e.g. #file-JAH-AI-SIG-001 via stamp, or #file-dom-chef).
Deep link to a word AI file (e.g. #wordai-JAH-AI-WORD-000001).
Deep link to a deterministic hybrid file, #1–#1000000.

endpoints.desc: Machine-readable catalog of the 270 embedded AI files, one AI File Standard record each: ID/NAME/TYPE/CATEGORY/DESCRIPTION/CAPABILITIES/LIMITATIONS/STATUS/VERSION/ROLE/RUNTIME/DEMO/VOICE/SIGNATURE_NUMBER/SOURCE/RELATIONSHIPS/HASH/ARTIFACTS.
This manifest: counts, endpoints, deep links, schema version, catalog revision.

note: Embedded counts are exact, parsed from index.html. The word-AI count is the live wordai index in signature-one-archive (grows on the word-spec drip). 1,000,000 is the deterministic Mix Lab hybrid combination space; hybrids actually forged are per-device and shown in the Mix Lab counter.
